ai_mode_agent_desc: Multi-step work. Can propose schema changes and writes that you review before they run.

ai_canvas_table_hint: Click to add to the chat context, double-click to open
ai_changes_mysql_notice: MySQL applies schema changes one at a time. If a step fails, the steps before it stay applied.

ai_agent_tier_data_write_desc: Proposes data changes for review, never schema changes.
ai_agent_tier_schema_change_desc: Proposes data and schema changes, each reviewed before it runs.

share_intro: Anyone with the link can see this dashboard, read-only, without an account. Each link works until it expires or you revoke it.

share_links_empty: No links yet. Create one above.

share_no_visits: Nobody has opened this link yet.

notification_settings_enabled_hint: Be told when a background query, import or export finishes or fails.
notification_settings_unfocused: Only when DBO is not in front
notification_settings_unfocused_hint: In front, a message in the app is enough. Behind other windows, the system tells you.
notification_settings_test_hint: Shows a message in the app and a system notification, so you can see that both reach you. Allow notifications if asked.
notification_test_system: This is the system notification. Notifications work.
notification_test_denied: The system blocked notifications. Allow DBO in your system or browser notification settings, then try again.
notification_test_failed: The system notification could not be shown.
notification_settings_background: Move a query to the background after (seconds)

notification_settings_keep_running_hint: DBO and its MCP server stay available. Quit from the tray menu.

notification_query_reopened: The query is in a new tab. Run it again when you are ready.
notification_settings_autostart: Start DBO when I sign in
notification_settings_autostart_hint: DBO opens hidden in the tray, so schedules and background work keep going.

schedule_email_missing: Email is not set up yet. An admin can add the outgoing account.
schedule_smtp_admin_only: Only an admin can change the email account.
ai_boards_empty: Pin reports to a board to see them together.
question_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? It is removed from every dashboard.
ai_tool_density_desc: How much of the agent's work shows in the chat.

backup_restore_warning: Restoring writes the backup into this database and can overwrite existing data. This cannot be undone.
backup_restore_type_name: Type the database name to confirm
backup_restore_blocked: Only the owner or an editor can restore
backup_tools_hint: Native tools make faster, more complete backups. Nothing is downloaded unless you ask.
backup_nav_schedules_hint: Run backups on a schedule and review every run.
backup_nav_destinations_hint: Where finished backups are stored besides this machine.
backup_nav_notifications_hint: Get told when a backup succeeds or fails.
backup_pick_connection: Add a connection to back it up
explorer_pick_connection: Choose a connection to browse its objects.
backup_form_source_hint: Pick the connection, then the database from the list.
backup_form_storage: Where it goes and how long it stays
backup_form_no_channels: No channels yet. Add one under Notifications to hear about runs.
backup_nav_restore_hint: Bring a backup back into a database. Pick one from the list or upload a file.

backup_tool_install_hint_mac: Install with Homebrew: brew install libpq mysql-client, or point DBO at the binaries you already have.
backup_tool_install_hint_linux: Install the client package (for example postgresql-client or mysql-client), or point DBO at the binaries you already have.
backup_tool_install_hint_windows: Install the PostgreSQL or MySQL client tools (winget install PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL), or point DBO at the binaries you already have.
backup_tool_path_hint: Use the client you already installed. DBO checks that it runs.
connector_folder_hint: Copy backups to a folder on this machine, such as a mounted network share.
connector_s3_hint: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi and others.
connector_sftp_hint: Copy over SSH. The server's host key is pinned on first connect.
connector_ftp_hint: Plain FTP or explicit FTPS. Prefer SFTP when you can.
connector_gdrive_hint: Uses your own Google OAuth client. DBO only sees files it creates.
connector_email_hint: Uses the SMTP account set up for dashboard emails.
connector_slack_hint: Post to a channel with an incoming webhook.
connector_discord_hint: Post to a channel with a webhook.
connector_telegram_hint: Send messages from your own bot.
connector_webhook_hint: Signed JSON POST for scripts, bots and automation.
backup_passphrase_weak: Weak: use more characters or Generate one
connector_secret_saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
connector_delete_confirm: Delete this connector? Schedules using it will keep running without it.
connector_authorize_hint: Save first, then authorize in your browser.
connector_empty_destinations_hint: Backups stay on this machine until you add somewhere to send them.
connector_empty_channels_hint: Add email, Slack, Discord, Telegram or a webhook to hear about backups.
backup_tool_admin_only: Only an administrator can download tools
backup_schedule_keep_smart_hint: Keeps one backup per day for a week, per week for a month and per month for a year. Older ones are deleted.
backup_schedule_retry_hint: A failed run is tried again after 5 minutes, then 10, 20 and so on. Only the last failure is reported.
backup_schedule_delete_confirm: Delete this schedule? Its existing backups are kept.
backup_schedule_needs_password: Scheduled runs need the connection password to be remembered.
backup_schedule_password_warning: Runs will fail: the password for this connection is not remembered. Reconnect with "remember password".
backup_job_empty: No backup jobs yet. Create one to back up on a schedule.
backup_wizard_local_folder_hint: Backups are stored in the backups folder on the machine running DBO. More destinations are planned.
backup_encrypt_warning: If you lose this passphrase the encrypted backups cannot be restored. DBO cannot recover it.
backup_restore_create_db: Create this database first (it must not exist)
backup_job_keep_passphrase: Leave empty to keep the current key. A new passphrase only applies to future backups.
onboarding_welcome_body: A fast, focused client for the databases you work with every day, with an AI that works beside you.
onboarding_connect_title: Whatever you run, bring it in.
onboarding_connect_body: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite, plus Supabase, Neon, Aurora, RDS and more. Your credentials stay on your machine.
onboarding_work_title: Browse, edit and query without friction.
onboarding_work_body: Inline editing, a SQL editor with autocomplete, diagrams and safe mode for risky changes.
onboarding_ai_title: An agent that reads, plans and proposes.
onboarding_ai_body: Ask in plain words. It inspects your schema, runs queries and proposes changes you review before anything is applied.
onboarding_account_body: Free to start. Sign in or sign up in your browser, then come straight back. You can skip this and do it later.
account_failed: Could not reach the DBO account server. Check your connection and try again.
account_connect_intro: Your account lives on dbo-studio.com. It opens in your browser, then brings you straight back here.
account_connect_hint: We opened the DBO website. Once you confirm there, this window continues by itself.
account_connect_manual: Did it not continue? Enter the code shown in your browser.
onboarding_theme_body: Light or dark, with a palette to match. The whole app follows, and you can change it any time in Settings, under Appearance.
onboarding_privacy_body: DBO can send anonymous usage statistics, so we know which features matter. It is on by default. Turn it off here and nothing is sent. You can change this later in Settings, under General.
onboarding_privacy_sent_1: Which features are used, and how often
onboarding_privacy_never_1: Your data, tables or query text
onboarding_privacy_never_2: Connection details, passwords or API keys
account_connect_point_1: Sign in with email, Google or GitHub
account_connect_point_2: Verify your email and reset your password on the website
account_connect_point_3: Come straight back to this window
